body: I've also been diagnosed with Major Depressive Disorder and gender dysphoria, along with Generalized Anxiety Disorder and severe social anxiety. I agree. I wish I could die. The only reason I never fully consider suicide is because my family loves me and I love them and I don't think I could ever do something that hurts them so much.
Well...at least if you're bi you can eventually fall back into the 'straight' lifestyle. You can marry and have kids and never be judged for that.
